_doc: Every contract copy this repo pins from a producer, and the producer branch it must equal. scripts/harness/pinned_contract_gate.py fails when a copy differs from the producer's develop. Refresh = copy the file, never edit it. The vendor-connectivity pin is the OpenAPI the outbound refusal table is held against (internal/adapters/outbound/retailnetwork/refusal_spec_test.go, ADR 0013). The last pin is the SELF-pin: this repo's own event catalog (the events topic and its .dlq companion), asserted by the E1-E4 contract tests in internal/adapters/inbound/kafka against the outbox encoder's published catalogue.
